title: Date utility library
issue: The billing calendar shows the wrong weekday for every date, the monthly renewal of a subscription started on 31 January produces an impossible date, and someone noticed that 29 February 2000 is rejected.

bugs.summary: isLeapYear misses the 400-year rule (2000 is a leap year).
addMonths does not clamp the day to the length of the target month.
getUTCDay() is 0 for Sunday but DAY_NAMES starts at Monday.
